verdict_reason: Switching to commodityCode is correct and matches the obligation, but the unweaned predicate is a third copy of a rule the obligation already owns, and the comments describe other modules.

todos.issue: The unweaned rule now has three homes, each re-pointed to commodityCode separately in this PR: validate.js:18-21 unweanedApplies (hand-rolled asArray + unweanedCommodityCodes().includes(line.commodityCode)), the containsUnweanedAnimals obligation in obligations/sections/commodities/aggregates.js:43 (anyAllowListed(commodityCode, unweanedCommodityCodes)), and a second function also called unweanedApplies in check-answers/view-model/applicability.js:28 that reads the obligation through appliesForGateValue. asArray (validate.js:14) also copies toArray from check-answers/view-model/rows/value-text.js. This PR had to change the key in more than one place, which shows the risk
todos.fix: Must: one function owns whether a set of stored commodity lines asks the unweaned question, built on the containsUnweanedAnimals obligation, and additional-details validation and check-answers both call it. One way: have validate.js import the applicability unweanedApplies (or a shared helper over appliesForGateValue('containsUnweanedAnimals', line.commodityCode)), and delete the local asArray and the local predicate

todos.issue: Comments describe other modules and carry rationale: lines 16-17 ('the stored reading has answers in hand but not scope. Same predicate the controller uses via scope.has(...)') describe the caller and the controller, not the lines below; lines 23-25 ('One rule, two audiences ... The unweaned rule takes no swap — its yes / no values are not a catalogue that changes') explain callers and a design choice about another constant
todos.fix: Must: no comment in validate.js describes callers, the controller or rationale; any rationale that still matters lives in the repo's docs/ or the behaviour spec. One way: delete both comments and let the names (unweanedApplies, certifiedField(stored)) carry the meaning, renaming the stored parameter if it does not
